title: [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois..., pages 650 bis à 787, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is item 7 of a long computation in the continuation of 'La Longue Marche'. The computation builds an arithmetic, group-scheme analogue of an extension of SL2(Z)- or modular-type groups over a base like Spec Z[1/n]. Its ingredients are a group scheme G_{ρ,σ}, built on the previous page as (Z_{ρ,σ}·S^+)/L_0^♮, and a canonical epimorphism χ: G_{ρ,σ} → O_12^*. Here S^+ is the 'discrete' part generated by elements ρ (order 3 or 6 type) and σ (order 4 type). O_12^* is a group of units mod 12, or a twisted form of it, through which arithmetic acts. On the previous page there is a canonical section μ ↦ u_μ of Z_{ρ,σ} over O_12^*, with u_μ acting on ρ by a power of λ_1.

On this page Grothendieck defines the 'normalizer' subgroup N_ρ = {u ∈ G_{ρ,σ} | u(ρ) = ρ^{ε_3(u)}}. These are the elements carrying ρ to ρ or ρ^{-1}, the sign ε_3 being read off from χ. A margin note says this notation is provisional (cf. p. 697).

He checks that χ restricted to N_ρ is still an epimorphism, 'to reassure ourselves'. Take a local section μ of O_12^*. Decompose its exponent ν via the invariants ν'' and ν_3, so that ν = 3ν'' − ν_3, a Chinese-remainder splitting of 12. Then u_μ(ρ) = λ_1^ν ρ = λ_1^{3ν''} λ_1^{-ν_3} ρ, which is shown to equal int(δ^{ν''} τ^{ν_3})(ρ) with δ = λ_1 λ_0^{-1}. A crossed-out special case ν_3 = 0 uses (1 − ρ_M)(δ) to identify λ_1^3-multiplication with conjugation by δ.

Hence int((δ^{ν''} τ_1^{ν_3})^{-1} u_μ) fixes ρ, so u = τ_1^{ν_3} δ^{-ν''} u_μ lies in N_ρ. Its character is χ(u) = χ(τ_1)^{ν_3} μ = (−1)^{ν_3} μ. Multiplying by (ωτ')^{ν_3}, with ωτ'τ = σ, corrects the sign. This gives an explicit lift v = σ^{ν_3} δ^{-ν''} u_μ ∈ N_ρ with χ(v) = μ.

The next page draws the conclusion: an exact sequence 1 → N_ρ^{**} → N_ρ → O_12^* → 1, with kernel the centralizer of ρ in S^+. In short, this is a routine verification that a stabilizer subgroup surjects onto the arithmetic quotient, via an explicit splitting.
errors: Equation numbering is inconsistent. After (151) on the previous page this page has (157), then labels read as (153)/(154) (the machine transcription has (183)/(184)), with (154) used twice. The next page restarts at (155)–(157).

There is a notational slip between τ and τ_1. Also (δ^{ν''}τ_1^{ν_3})^{-1} is written as τ_1^{ν_3}δ^{-ν''}. That is only correct if τ_1^2 = 1 (or is central and is absorbed) and δ, τ_1 commute suitably; this is not justified on the page.
The sign correction step depends on χ(ωτ') = (−1) and on ωτ'τ = σ, both defined elsewhere. The argument is not self-contained on this page, but there is no evident error.

ideas.what: Normalizer-type subgroup N_ρ = {u | u(ρ) = ρ^{±1}} of an arithmetic group scheme extension of a modular-type group by O_12^*, and the surjectivity of χ on it with an explicit section
ideas.modern_name: Stabilizer/normalizer of an elliptic (torsion) element in an extension of SL2(Z)-like group by a Galois/units group; decomposition-group-type exact sequence
ideas.usually_credited_to: unsure (general ideas: Grothendieck's anabelian/Teichmüller tower programme; decomposition groups of elliptic points)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses the role of the orders-2 and 3 elements of SL2(Z) / Teichmüller tower in low dimension, but not this computation

ideas.what: Using the canonical section O_12^* → Z_{ρ,σ} and correcting by inner automorphisms (δ^{ν''}τ^{ν_3}) to land in the stabilizer of ρ
ideas.modern_name: Lifting via a split extension, twisting a section by inner automorphisms

deep.surprise_reason: A routine verification step ('vérifions-le pour nous rassurer') inside a larger unpublished construction of arithmetic group schemes attached to ρ, σ. The overall programme is notable, but this page adds no standalone result or connection.
transcription_corrections: Equation labels on the page read (153) and (154), (154), not (183)/(184)/(184).
The target group of χ is written as a blackboard/outlined O_12^* (the next-page transcription 'D_12^*' should be O_12^*).
The margin note reads 'notation provisoire, cf plus bas p. 697'.
The other margin note reads 'NB on note χ l'hom canon G_{ρ,σ} → O_12^*'.
